messages:
Maria: quick thought — we should add a single /deploy command that pins a release and attaches a release-note template + change-window metadata. I'm tired of doing these 5 manual steps every time.

Kevin: SG. What flags are you thinking?

Maria: idea: `/deploy pin` subcommand with optional annotation + templated notes. example syntax:
```
/deploy pin --ver v2.3.1 --owner @Kevin --change-window \"2025-07-22 10:00-11:00 UTC\" \\
  --notes-template release_notes.md --snapshot-metrics --dry-run
```
And a simple template we can keep in infra: `/infra/deploy/templates/release_notes.md`
```
Title: v2.3.1 Release
- Summary: short bullet on user-facing change
- Rollback plan: steps to rollback to v2.3.0
- Impact: regions/services affected
- DB migrations: yes/no + migration window
- Monitoring: dashboards/alerts to watch
- Owners: @owner, @oncall
- Snapshot artifacts: <pre-deploy-metrics-url>
```

Tiago: add `--snapshot-metrics` as an explicit flag that runs a quick perf/latency snapshot pre-deploy and stores artifacts with the pin id. Could be a separate subcommand `/deploy snapshot --tag pin-<id>` too. :+1:

Sophie: also want `--annotate "freeform text"` so the pin shows up with that note in the console and in the webhook payloads. We should include an opt-in `--create-pr` that opens a release-notes PR from the template.

Rahul: I can prototype the CLI handler and bot code. couple questions: where to keep templates (you said infra repo) and what S3 path for snapshots? also do we want auto-rollout or explicit approve?

Maria: yes infra repo is fine. default S3 prefix `s3://redwood-deploy-snapshots/{team}/{pin_id}/`. And default to manual approve — `--auto-rollout` opt-in. acceptance criteria: idempotent pin, snapshot artifact URL included in release notes, dry-run simulates everything without creating pins or pushing snapshots.

deploy-bot: Created issue INFR-452: "pin+annotate+snapshot deploy command" — assigned to @Rahul, epic=deploy-tooling, link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INFR-452

Kevin: love it. can we also default `--no-auto-rollout` unless `--auto-rollout` is specified? :eyes:

Maria: yup — i'll add a tiny RFC in /docs/deploy/rfcs and drop an acceptance checklist: idempotent pin, annotate + console display, snapshot artifact stored and linked, dry-run, optional PR creation, integrate with canary flow. I can spin up a quick PR to infra templates tomorrow.

Sophie: happy to review the PR.

Tiago: I'll sketch the snapshot lambda to collect p95/p99 and a small loadgen for warmup.

Kevin: thanks all — this should shave off 10 min per release. :tada:
